name: auto-handoff
description: Hands a Claude Code session off to a fresh one before the context fills: a Haiku-written brief that carries the previous brief and the project history, /clear, and a seed that points the new session at the brief. Also on request: /handoff, or the handoff tool.

threshold.title: Handoff threshold (tokens)
threshold.description: Context size that triggers a handoff. 20k before it, the model is asked to finish its step and hand off with its own brief. The 150k default is the measured optimum for token cost plus wall time (see config.ts). Never closer than 40k to the context window, so a 300k setting becomes 160k on a 200k window. AUTO_HANDOFF_TOKENS overrides it for a test run, and /handoff 60k for one session. A seeded session hands off no sooner than 40k past its starting size; the panel above the prompt says so when this is set lower.

maxConsecutiveHandoffs.title: Handoffs in a row without a message
maxConsecutiveHandoffs.description: Handoffs allowed before you type a prompt. Past this the mod pauses until you send one.

briefTemplate.title: Brief template file
briefTemplate.description: Markdown file that tells Haiku which sections to write. Created with the defaults on first run; edit it to change the brief.

instructionsTemplate.title: Instructions template file
instructionsTemplate.description: Markdown file that tells the fresh session how to read the brief. Created with the defaults on first run.

ignoreFiles.title: Ignored files (regex)
ignoreFiles.description: Edited files matching this pattern are left out of the brief, such as auto-synced state or caches. Leave blank for none.

viewer.title: Viewer address
viewer.description: Where the mod serves a readable page for each brief, as host:port. "tailscale" as the host means this machine's Tailscale IP (tailscale:3846), so only your tailnet can open it; without Tailscale it serves on 127.0.0.1. Blank, the default: no server, and the link is the local file.

historyLines.title: Project history lines
historyLines.description: How many lines of project history a brief carries: recent sessions whole, older ones merged. About 150 tokens a line at most.

briefWriter.title: Brief writer
briefWriter.description: fork: the session's own model writes the brief over its cached transcript and sees the whole session (better carryover; billed as cache reads plus its output). haiku: Haiku writes it from the last 120 messages (cheaper). A failed fork falls back to Haiku.
